description: Prepare an attributable request for an existing work packet, a canonical definition, or a specific objective. Unlike posting a new packet, this asks the existing /labor/request bridge to resolve the need to one governed packet or an explicit blocker. Your own wallet signs the exact MESSAGE_TO_SIGN locally; never provide a private key. Set requesterKind=agent only when an agent is the genuine requester; do not relabel a human request as agent demand. Optional lat/lng must come explicitly from an entitled caller, never inferred from device or host location. A request does NOT fund a job, hire anyone, grant site access, or certify an ecological outcome. It is free when the signed waiver lane is enabled. Check the real gate's response.

definitionId.description: Request existing documented work that may not have a posting yet. Mutually exclusive with workId and objective.

lat.description: Optional real latitude from the requester, never inferred; give with lng to locate the objective.

lng.description: Optional real longitude from the requester, never inferred; give with lat.

note.description: Optional public context, at most 280 characters. No secrets, names or contact details.

objective.description: Describe the needed outcome in 5-300 characters. Mutually exclusive with workId and definitionId.

requesterKind.description: Who actually requests the work. Use agent only for true agent-originated demand.

requesterWallet.description: 0x address the requester controls and will sign with. Never submit a private key.

workId.description: Request an existing posted packet by its workId. Mutually exclusive with definitionId and objective.

name: prepare_request
title: Ask for real work at a place (prepare signed request)
